    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q1. Missing Data Identification"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "_SGKIlJ6l2_S"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Identify total missing values in each column\n",
        "missing_counts = df.isnull().sum()\n",
        "print(\"Missing Values per Column:\\n\", missing_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate the percentage of missing data\n",
        "missing_percentage = (df.isnull().sum() / len(df)) * 100\n",
        "print(\"\\nPercentage of Missing Data:\\n\", missing_percentage)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "TimMP6vemDI_",
        "outputId": "ecb56c54-3675-4c02-c88d-83d947d484a5"
      },

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q2. Handling Missing Age"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hVQS9Yk2mVC8"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Impute missing Age with the median\n",
        "median_age = df['Age'].median()\n",
        "df['Age'] = df['Age'].fillna(median_age)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "DDF8V4-smZvm"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q3. Handling Missing Treatment Cost"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "h92L1vQVmeKa"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Impute missing Treatment_Cost with the median\n",
        "median_cost = df['Treatment_Cost'].median()\n",
        "df['Treatment_Cost'] = df['Treatment_Cost'].fillna(median_cost)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9RdFfPtamgIu"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q4. Duplicate Patient Records"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ap4cNBNxmotw"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Compare size before\n",
        "size_before = df.shape\n",
        "print(\"Dataset size before removing duplicates:\", size_before)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Identify duplicate rows\n",
        "duplicate_count = df.duplicated().sum()\n",
        "print(\"Number of duplicate rows found:\", duplicate_count)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove duplicates\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Compare size after\n",
        "size_after = df.shape\n",
        "print(\"Dataset size after removing duplicates:\", size_after)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "ZfAFgWmpmrZr",
        "outputId": "41101e57-dc64-4f8d-e13b-c99ffab7a8d3"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Dataset size before removing duplicates: (5100, 9)\n",
            "Number of duplicate rows found: 99\n",
            "Dataset size after removing duplicates: (5001, 9)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q5. Invalid Age Values (Data Quality Check)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "xdhh-pHlmvlS"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Detect unrealistic age values\n",
        "invalid_ages = df[(df['Age'] < 0) | (df['Age'] > 100)]\n",
        "print(\"Number of invalid age records:\", len(invalid_ages))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Decision: Correct negative ages and cap extreme old ages\n",
        "# Taking the absolute value fixes simple negative sign typos\n",
        "df['Age'] = df['Age'].abs()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Cap ages over 100 to a reasonable maximum (e.g., 100), or drop if preferred.\n",
        "# Here we will cap them.\n",
        "df.loc[df['Age'] > 100, 'Age'] = 100"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "crJyvZdHmx-h",
        "outputId": "f0ad3b3f-e4eb-4111-d0db-12905804bc47"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Number of invalid age records: 0\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q6. Outlier Detection"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "1McAxSeVm2Vu"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Calculate Q1 and Q3\n",
        "Q1 = df['Treatment_Cost'].quantile(0.25)\n",
        "Q3 = df['Treatment_Cost'].quantile(0.75)\n",
        "IQR = Q3 - Q1\n",
        "\n",
        "# Define boundaries\n",
        "lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR\n",
        "upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR\n",
        "\n",
        "# Detect outliers\n",
        "outliers = df[(df['Treatment_Cost'] < lower_bound) | (df['Treatment_Cost'] > upper_bound)]\n",
        "print(\"Number of outliers in Treatment Cost:\", len(outliers))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "YbdWk5lmm4FR",
        "outputId": "d35d472e-01a1-44d7-944a-2773cbbd9d88"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Number of outliers in Treatment Cost: 50\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q7. Outlier Treatment"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "J2IRX_0Em7bd"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Determine the 5th and 95th percentiles\n",
        "lower_percentile = df['Treatment_Cost'].quantile(0.05)\n",
        "upper_percentile = df['Treatment_Cost'].quantile(0.95)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Apply capping (Winsorization)\n",
        "df['Treatment_Cost'] = np.clip(df['Treatment_Cost'], lower_percentile, upper_percentile)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "qrlHzpoKm9Ho"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q8. Transformation"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "KKTOXeVrm_yg"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Apply log transformation (using log1p to safely handle any zeros)\n",
        "df['Log_Treatment_Cost'] = np.log1p(df['Treatment_Cost'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Compare distributions using visualizations\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['Treatment_Cost'], kde=True, ax=axes[0], color='blue')\n",
        "axes[0].set_title('Original Treatment Cost Distribution')\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.histplot(df['Log_Treatment_Cost'], kde=True, ax=axes[1], color='green')\n",
        "axes[1].set_title('Log Transformed Treatment Cost Distribution')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 108
        },
        "id": "O8cVPxF6nBXr",
        "outputId": "18595d2d-38c8-4bfe-afbe-040a65d80e51"
      },

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "Q9. Time-Based Missing Handling"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "QoIeu23tnE_B"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Ensure Admission_Date is a datetime object\n",
        "df['Admission_Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Admission_Date'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sort data by Admission_Date\n",
        "df = df.sort_values(by='Admission_Date')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Apply Forward Fill for time-series consistency\n",
        "df = df.ffill()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "7oLa7TQonGuP"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    }
  ]
